# NCAAF Tuesday - Oct 27

Edge factor ~0.58 applied.

## Pick
- **Western Kentucky -1.5 vs Delaware (-105), 0.5u.** Reverse line movement: opened Delaware -2.5, now WKU -1.5 despite ~100% of spread bets/money on Delaware. Blue Chip model WKU -5.7; WagerTalk projection WKU 27-23. Against: Dimers 51.3% WKU win and Kalshi 50% (coin flip). Delaware QB Minicucci playing through a leg injury; Delaware also without Salazer and Spiller. Raw ~55% -> 52.9% vs 51.2% implied. Small because two sources call it a coin flip and we are buying after the move.

## Passes
- Sam Houston +6.5 at Missouri State: WagerTalk projects MSU by 3, but Dimers' 71.5% MSU win probability matches the -6.5 line. No edge.
- Both unders (56.5, 49.5): totals have fallen below the openers (58.5, 50.5); under rule needs above the opener.
